ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Coma uses the camera so you can send photos and videos to chats.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Coma opens your library so you can attach photos and videos to messages and pick a profile photo.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Coma uses the microphone to record voice messages and video for chats.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Coma saves photos and videos from chats to your library when you ask it to.
